title: Knotted Crunchy Uruguayan Bread Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish featuring strong white bread flour and clay pot cooking, these empanadas are perfect for a snack or light meal. They are shojin friendly and offer a unique crunchy texture.
instructions: Combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add olive oil and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the clay pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a tablespoon of filling in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling and knot the top to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas in the preheated clay pot and cook for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy.
